usedFor: Connecteam holds your team members, and Google Drive shares a file when “New User” runs “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Connecteam, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new hire can receive a link to an onboarding file the moment their account exists.

watchOut: Anyone with the link gets in, so set Viewer rather than Editor on “Share File With Anyone” for staff files.
